normalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 rendered row text after ANSI-control removal and outer-whitespace trimming.
policy: Human-reviewed readable prose, dialogue, generic menu fields, captions, placeholder copy, and explicit filler text found by disjoint punctuation, clustered-row, short-multiword, single-caption, and targeted placeholder detectors were blanked when row-level redaction preserved the surrounding ANSI artwork, controls, backgrounds, and geometry. Artist and group attribution, titles, filenames, dates, source-significant labels, thematic captions, repeated lettering used as structural texture, and large typographic art were retained.
